jobs.prompt: Semi-realistic illustrated character art, faces drawn in Japanese SHONEN-MANGA style (sharp expressive eyes, confident inked linework), MATURE ADULT proportions (7-8 heads tall), rich painted shading. NOT moe, NOT chibi, NOT cute-anime, NOT flat vector. Full body standing, feet visible, each figure with a distinctive silhouette (hats, props, hairstyles, poses), slightly exaggerated facial expressions as specified, no ground shadow, no text, isolated on transparent background. Arrange exactly 4 figures in ONE horizontal row, from left to right, all full-body, with generous empty space between them (they must not overlap or touch). Every figure has a different facial expression. Figure 1 (far left): a nervous young male office rookie in a rumpled dark suit with a loosened tie, sweat drops on his forehead, cringing with a stiff bowed posture and hands clasped near his chest. Figure 2 (left-center): a furious section manager (buchou) in a gray suit, fists clenched, veins bulging on his forehead, mouth wide open shouting, face red, leaning forward aggressively. Figure 3 (right-center): a smug accountant with round glasses and a sly lopsided grin, hands in his pockets, a calculator tucked under one arm, chin raised. Figure 4 (far right): a sleepy engineer in a hoodie with a lanyard, one hand covering a wide yawn, eyes half-closed, messy hair, holding a coffee mug.
